title: 连…也 / 都… and 甚至: even
explain: 连 … 也 / 都 … means 'even'. Put the surprising thing after 连, then 也 or 都 before the verb: 他连饭都没吃 'He did not even eat'. The thing after 连 is the most extreme case, one you would expect to be easy or obvious.

Most sentences are negative: 我连他的名字也不知道 'I do not even know his name'. A positive one is fine when the surprise is how easy or how small the thing is: 这个字连小孩子都能写 'Even small children can write this character'.
甚至 'even, to the point of' adds a stronger case after a weaker one: 他很累，甚至在车上睡着了 'He is tired, he even fell asleep in the car'. It often comes before 连: 他甚至连自己的名字都忘了 'He even forgot his own name'.

examples.zh: 他连饭都没吃就走了。
examples.en: He left without even eating.

examples.zh: 我连他的名字也不知道。
examples.en: I do not even know his name.

examples.zh: 这个字很简单，连小孩子都能写。
examples.en: This character is easy; even small children can write it.

examples.zh: 他很忙，甚至没有时间吃饭。
examples.en: He is very busy; he does not even have time to eat.

mistakes: Put 也 or 都 after the thing, before the verb. 他连饭没吃 is incomplete; say 他连饭都没吃.
Use 也 or 都, not both: 他连饭也都没吃 is wrong.

q.zh: 他昨天连手机都没带。
q.en: He did not even bring his phone yesterday.
q.explain: 连 + thing + 都 + verb.

q.zh: 他累得甚至在车上睡着了。
q.en: He was so tired that he even fell asleep in the car.
q.explain: 甚至 comes before the extreme case.

q.zh: 他连一句汉语都不会说。
q.en: He cannot even say one sentence of Chinese.
q.explain: 连 marks the extreme case.

q.prompt: Which sentence says: I do not even have time to eat?
options: 我连吃饭的时间都没有。
q.zh: 我连吃饭的时间都没有。
q.en: I do not even have time to eat.
q.explain: 连 comes right before the thing that is "even".

q.zh: 他连饭也不吃。
q.en: He does not even eat.
q.explain: After 连 use 也 or 都, not both.

title: 即使…也… and 尽管…: even if, although
explain: 即使 … 也 … 'even if' says that the result stays the same whatever happens: 即使下雨，我也去 'Even if it rains, I will go'. 即使 gives a situation that may or may not happen, and 也 (or 还是) comes in the second part.

尽管 … 还是 / 但是 … 'although, in spite of the fact that' is for something that is true: 尽管很累，他还是去上班了 'Although he was tired, he still went to work'. Compare 即使 (maybe it happens) with 尽管 (it really is so).
In the second part use 还是 'still' or 但是 'but'. 还是 is the more natural partner of 尽管. You can drop the English 'but', and Chinese does too: 尽管很贵，我还是买了 'Although it was dear, I still bought it'.

examples.zh: 即使明天下雨，我也要去。
examples.en: Even if it rains tomorrow, I will go.

examples.zh: 即使你不喜欢，也要吃一点儿。
examples.en: Even if you do not like it, you must eat a little.

examples.zh: 尽管天气很冷，他还是出去跑步了。
examples.en: Although the weather was cold, he still went out running.

examples.zh: 尽管她很累，但是她不想休息。
examples.en: Although she is tired, she does not want to rest.

mistakes: 即使 is for something that may or may not happen. For something that is a fact, use 尽管: 尽管下雨了，我们还是去了.
Do not leave out 也 / 还是 in the second part. 即使下雨，我去 sounds unfinished.

q.zh: 即使很晚，他也不睡觉。
q.en: Even if it is late, he does not sleep.
q.explain: 即使 gives the situation, 也 the unchanged result.

q.zh: 尽管很累，我还是要学习。
q.en: Although I am tired, I still want to study.
q.explain: 尽管 + situation, 还是 + result.

q.zh: 即使你不去，我也会去。
q.en: Even if you do not go, I will go.
q.explain: 即使 = even if.

q.prompt: Which sentence says: Although it was dear, I still bought it?
q.zh: 尽管很贵，我还是买了。
q.en: Although it was dear, I still bought it.
q.explain: 尽管 goes with 还是, not 所以.

q.zh: 即使下雨，我也去。
q.en: Even if it rains, I still go.
q.explain: 即使 does not go with 所以; 也 is enough.

title: 不管 / 无论…都…: no matter
formula: Question word, or A 还是 B
explain: 不管 and 无论 both mean 'no matter'. They are followed by a question word or by 'A or B', and then 都 (or 也) gives the result that does not change: 不管你去哪儿，我都跟你去 'No matter where you go, I will go with you'.
A pair like 好不好 or a list with 还是 works too: 不管天气好不好，他都去跑步 'Whether the weather is good or not, he goes running'; 不管是大的还是小的，我都喜欢 'Whether it is big or small, I like it'.
无论 is a little more formal than 不管. The second part nearly always has 都: 无论多忙，她都给妈妈打电话 'No matter how busy she is, she calls her mother'.

examples.zh: 不管你去哪儿，我都跟你去。
examples.en: No matter where you go, I will go with you.

examples.zh: 不管天气好不好，他都去跑步。
examples.en: Whether the weather is good or not, he goes running.

examples.zh: 无论多忙，她都给妈妈打电话。
examples.en: No matter how busy she is, she calls her mother.

examples.zh: 不管谁来，我们都欢迎。
examples.en: No matter who comes, we welcome them.

mistakes: Do not forget 都 in the result. 不管谁来，我们欢迎 is not complete; use 都 (or 也).
不管 is for something that can change: who, where, how much. For a fact, use 尽管.

q.zh: 不管多忙，他都来。
q.en: No matter how busy he is, he comes.
q.explain: 不管 + question word, 都 + result.

q.zh: 不管你说什么，我都相信你。
q.en: No matter what you say, I believe you.
q.explain: The question word 什么 stands for "anything".

q.zh: 无论你在哪儿，都要给我打电话。
q.en: No matter where you are, you must call me.
q.explain: 无论 = no matter (a little more formal).

q.prompt: Which sentence says: No matter who it is, I want to help?
q.zh: 不管是谁，我都想帮助。
q.en: No matter who it is, I want to help.
q.explain: 不管 goes with 都.

q.zh: 不管天气怎么样，我们都去。
q.en: No matter what the weather is like, we go.
q.wrong: 不管天气怎么样，但是我们都去。
q.explain: Do not add 但是 after 不管.

title: 要是…就… and 既然…就…: if, and since
explain: 要是 … 就 … means 'if', like 如果 but more spoken: 要是明天下雨，我们就不去 'If it rains tomorrow, we will not go'. Like 如果, 要是 can come before or after the subject: 要是你累了，就休息吧 or 你要是累了，就休息吧.
The result part usually has 就. In speech 的话 can be added at the end of the first part: 你要是不想去的话，就别去 'If you do not want to go, then do not go'.
既然 … 就 … means 'since, now that'. It is for something that is already true or known: 既然你累了，就休息吧 'Since you are tired, rest'. 要是 imagines something; 既然 accepts a fact.

examples.zh: 要是你有时间，就来我家玩。
examples.en: If you have time, come and play at my home.

examples.zh: 你要是不舒服，就去看医生吧。
examples.en: If you are not feeling well, go and see a doctor.

examples.zh: 既然你累了，就早点休息吧。
examples.en: Since you are tired, rest early.

examples.zh: 既然已经来了，就多坐一会儿吧。
examples.en: Since you have already come, sit a bit longer.

mistakes: Do not use 要是 for facts. 要是你已经来了 is odd, because you are already here. Use 既然.
Keep 就 in the second part: 既然你累了，你就应该休息.

q.zh: 要是下雨，我们就不去。
q.en: If it rains, we will not go.
q.explain: 要是 gives the "if", 就 the result.

q.zh: 既然你已经累了，就休息吧。
q.en: Since you are already tired, rest.
q.explain: 既然 + known fact, 就 + advice.

q.zh: 你要是有问题，就问老师。
q.en: If you have a question, ask the teacher.
q.explain: 要是 = if.

q.prompt: Which sentence says: Since it is already late, let us go home?
options: 既然已经很晚了，我们就回家吧。
要是已经很晚了，我们就回家吧。
q.zh: 既然已经很晚了，我们就回家吧。
q.en: Since it is already late, let us go home.
q.explain: 既然 accepts a fact that is already true.

q.zh: 要是你累，就休息吧。
q.en: If you are tired, rest.
q.wrong: 要是你累，所以就休息吧。
q.explain: Do not add 所以 after 要是; 就 is enough.

title: 否则, 由于…因此… and 于是: otherwise, because … so, and so
explain: 否则 means 'otherwise, or else'. It starts the second part and tells what will happen if the first part is not done or not true: 快一点走，否则我们会迟到 'Hurry up, or we will be late'. What follows 否则 is nearly always something you do not want.

由于 … 因此 … 'because of …, so …' is the written form of 因为…所以…: 由于天气不好，因此我们没有出去玩 'Because the weather was bad, we did not go out to play'. 由于 gives the reason; 因此 gives the result. In speech people usually say 因为…所以….

于是 'so, and then' links two things that happen one after the other, where the second is a reaction to the first: 他很饿，于是去买了一个面包 'He was hungry, so he went and bought a bread roll'. Unlike 所以, 于是 tells a story in order.

examples.zh: 快一点走，否则我们会迟到。
examples.en: Hurry up, or we will be late.

examples.zh: 你要多喝水，否则会不舒服。
examples.en: You must drink more water, or you will feel unwell.

examples.zh: 由于天气不好，因此我们没有出去玩。
examples.en: Because the weather was bad, we did not go out to play.

examples.zh: 他很饿，于是去买了一个面包。
examples.en: He was hungry, so he went and bought a bread roll.

mistakes: 否则 starts the second part and is followed by something unwanted. Do not use it for a good result.
因此 needs a reason before it to point back to: 由于…，因此….

q.zh: 快一点，否则你会迟到。
q.en: Hurry up, or you will be late.
q.explain: 否则 = or else.

q.zh: 他很累，于是回家休息了。
q.en: He was tired, so he went home to rest.
q.explain: 于是 = so, and then.

q.zh: 由于下雨，因此比赛晚了一个小时。
q.en: Because of the rain, the game was an hour late.
q.explain: 因此 gives the result of the reason.

q.prompt: Which sentence says: Go to bed early, or you will be tired tomorrow?
options: 早一点睡觉，否则明天会很累。
早一点睡觉，于是明天会很累。
q.zh: 早一点睡觉，否则明天会很累。
q.en: Go to bed early, or you will be tired tomorrow.
q.explain: 否则 gives the unwanted result.

q.zh: 早一点睡觉，否则明天会很累。
q.en: Go to bed early, or you will be tired tomorrow.
q.wrong: 早一点睡觉，否则如果明天会很累。
q.explain: 否则 already means "if not"; do not add 如果.

title: 然而, 不过, 并且 and 而: however, and also
explain: 然而 and 不过 both mean 'however, but'. They start the second part and turn it against the first: 这个菜很便宜，不过不太好吃 'This dish is cheap, but not very tasty'. 然而 is more formal and is used in writing; 不过 is spoken and softer than 可是 or 但是.
并且 'and also, moreover' adds a second thing that is just as true: 他会说汉语，并且说得很好 'He can speak Chinese, and he speaks it well'. It joins verbs or short clauses and is more formal than 而且.
而 joins two parts that are in contrast, two sides of one picture: 他很高，而他的弟弟不太高 'He is tall, while his younger brother is not very tall'. It is often written and often has no English word of its own.

examples.zh: 这个菜很便宜，不过不太好吃。
examples.en: This dish is cheap, but not very tasty.

examples.zh: 我很想去，不过今天没有时间。
examples.en: I very much want to go, but I have no time today.

examples.zh: 这个地方很有名，然而去的人不多。
examples.en: This place is famous, but not many people go.

examples.zh: 他会说汉语，并且说得很好。
examples.en: He can speak Chinese, and he speaks it well.

mistakes: Do not put 不过 or 然而 in the first part. They always start the part that contrasts.
并且 adds; it does not contrast. For a contrast use 而 or 但是.

q.zh: 这件衣服很漂亮，不过有点儿贵。
q.en: This piece of clothing is pretty, but a little dear.
q.explain: 不过 starts the part that goes against the first.

q.zh: 她会唱歌，并且唱得很好。
q.en: She can sing, and she sings well.
q.explain: 并且 adds a second good thing.

q.zh: 这个地方很大，然而人很少。
q.en: This place is big, but there are very few people.
q.explain: 然而 = however (formal).

q.prompt: Which sentence says: He is tall, while his brother is not?
options: 他很高，而他的弟弟不高。
他很高，并且他的弟弟不高。
q.zh: 他很高，而他的弟弟不高。
q.en: He is tall, while his younger brother is not.
q.explain: 而 shows two sides; 并且 only adds.

q.zh: 我很想去，不过没有时间。
q.en: I very much want to go, but I have no time.
q.wrong: 我很想去，不过但是没有时间。
q.explain: Use 不过 or 但是, not both.

title: 既…又… and 不是…而是…: both … and, not … but
explain: 既…又… 'both … and' joins two qualities or two actions of the same thing: 这个手机既便宜又好用 'This phone is both cheap and easy to use'. It is more formal than 又…又… (HSK 3), and the two parts are usually the same kind and length.
不是 … 而是 … 'not … but …' corrects an idea. Put the wrong idea after 不是 and the true one after 而是: 我不是不想去，而是没有时间 'It is not that I do not want to go; I have no time'.
The two parts match in kind: 不是你，而是他 'Not you, but him'; 不是今天，而是明天 'Not today, but tomorrow'.

examples.zh: 这个手机既便宜又好用。
examples.en: This phone is both cheap and easy to use.

examples.zh: 她既聪明又努力。
examples.en: She is both clever and hard-working.

examples.zh: 我不是不想去，而是没有时间。
examples.en: It is not that I do not want to go; I have no time.

examples.zh: 他不是老师，而是医生。
examples.en: He is not a teacher but a doctor.

mistakes: 既 needs 又 to go with it: 既便宜，好用 is wrong.
不是…而是… needs both parts. 他不是老师，医生 is not complete.

q.zh: 这个房间既大又干净。
q.en: This room is both big and clean.
q.explain: 既 + quality, 又 + quality.

q.zh: 他不是学生，而是老师。
q.en: He is not a student but a teacher.
q.explain: 不是 + wrong idea, 而是 + true idea.

q.zh: 她既会唱歌，又会跳舞。
q.en: She can both sing and dance.
q.explain: 既 starts the pair.

q.prompt: Which sentence says: This is not tea but coffee?
q.zh: 这不是茶，而是咖啡。
q.en: This is not tea but coffee.
q.explain: 不是 goes with 而是.

q.zh: 这个菜既好吃又便宜。
q.en: This dish is both tasty and cheap.
q.wrong: 这个菜既好吃又也便宜。
q.explain: 又 follows 既; do not add 也.

title: 首先…其次…, 另外, 例如 and 同时: listing and adding
explain: 首先 'first of all' and 其次 'second, next' list reasons or steps in order, and 最后 'finally' ends the list: 首先要多听，其次要多说，最后要多写 'First listen a lot, second speak a lot, last write a lot'. They help you organise what you say.

另外 'besides, also' and 此外 'in addition' add one more thing. 另外 is spoken and 此外 is formal. They start the new part, followed by a comma: 这个房间很大；另外，它离学校也很近 'This room is big; besides, it is close to the school'.

例如 and 比如 'for example' introduce examples: 我喜欢运动，例如游泳、跑步 'I like sports, for example swimming and running'. 同时 'at the same time' joins two things that happen together, or two points that are both true: 他在工作，同时也在学习汉语 'He is working and at the same time studying Chinese'.

examples.zh: 首先要多听，其次要多说。
examples.en: First you must listen a lot; second you must speak a lot.

examples.zh: 这个房间很大；另外，它离学校也很近。
examples.en: This room is big; besides, it is close to the school.

examples.zh: 我喜欢运动，例如游泳、跑步。
examples.en: I like sports, for example swimming and running.

examples.zh: 他在工作，同时也在学习汉语。
examples.en: He is working and at the same time studying Chinese.

mistakes: 其次 needs 首先 before it. Do not start a list with 其次.
例如 is followed by the examples themselves, not by a whole new idea.

q.zh: 首先要认真听，其次要多练习。
q.en: First you must listen carefully; second you must practise more.
q.explain: 首先 gives the first point, 其次 the second.

q.zh: 我喜欢水果，例如苹果和西瓜。
q.en: I like fruit, for example apples and watermelons.
q.explain: 例如 comes right before the examples.

q.zh: 这家饭店很好；另外，离我家也很近。
q.en: This restaurant is good; besides, it is also close to my home.
q.explain: 另外 adds one more point.

q.prompt: Which sentence says: He is working and studying at the same time?
options: 他在工作，同时也在学习。
他在工作，其次也在学习。
q.zh: 他在工作，同时也在学习。
q.en: He is working and studying at the same time.
q.explain: 同时 joins two things happening together.

q.zh: 首先要多听，其次要多说。
q.en: First you must listen a lot; second you must speak a lot.
q.wrong: 首先要多听，最后其次要多说。
q.explain: Use 其次 for the second point, not 最后 as well.

title: 不得不, 来不及 and 赶快: no choice, too late, quickly
explain: 不得不 'have no choice but to' says you do something you would rather not do, because you must: 太晚了，我不得不回家 'It is too late; I have to go home'. 只好 means almost the same, 'can only, the only thing left is to': 没有车，我们只好走路 'There is no bus, so we can only walk'. Both show that there is no other way.

来得及 'there is still time' and 来不及 'there is no time, too late' can stand alone or follow a clause: 现在走还来得及 'If we leave now, there is still time'; 来不及了 'Too late!'. They look forward at time that is left or gone.

赶快 and 赶紧 both mean 'quickly, without delay'. They go before the verb. 赶快 is often used in commands: 赶快去吧 'Go quickly'. 赶紧 is used for things that happened too: 他赶紧给医生打了电话 'He quickly called the doctor'.

examples.zh: 太晚了，我不得不回家。
examples.en: It is too late; I have to go home.

examples.zh: 没有公共汽车，我们只好走路。
examples.en: There is no bus, so we have to walk.

examples.zh: 我们现在走还来得及。
examples.en: If we leave now, there is still time.

examples.zh: 你赶快去吧，别迟到。
examples.en: Go quickly, do not be late.

mistakes: 不得不 has two negatives but means 'have to'. Say 我不得不回家, not 我不得不要回家.

q.zh: 下雨了，我们只好在家看电影。
q.en: It has started to rain, so we have to watch a film at home.
q.explain: 只好 = the only thing left is to.

q.zh: 他不舒服，不得不请假。
q.en: He feels unwell, so he has to ask for leave.
q.explain: 不得不 = have no choice but to.

q.zh: 现在时间不多了，我们赶快走吧。
q.en: There is not much time now; let us go quickly.
q.explain: 赶快 goes before the verb.

q.prompt: Which sentence says: There is still time to go now?
q.zh: 现在去还来得及。
q.en: There is still time to go now.
q.explain: 来得及 = there is still time; 来不及 = too late.

q.zh: 来不及了，我们赶紧走吧。
q.en: It is already too late; let us hurry.
q.wrong: 来不及了，我们赶紧快走吧。
q.explain: Do not use 赶紧 and 快 together.
